title: Vistralo: from a website you admire to a brief your team can build
description: Capture a reference website, review its structure and motion, and edit an evidence-backed brief in Vistralo.

hero.label: For teams that start from a reference
hero.title: Turn a website you admire into a brief your team can build.
hero.support: Capture the page. Review its structure, spacing and motion. Give your team a brief with the evidence attached.
hero.footnote: Access is currently provided by invitation.

workflow.title: Keep the reference. Capture the reasoning.
workflow.support: A useful handoff connects what you see to what your team needs to build.

steps.title: Capture the details
steps.copy: Record a public website at your chosen viewport. Collect frames, visible styles and observed interactions together.

steps.title: Review the evidence
steps.copy: Inspect the captured moments and measured behavior. Coverage notes show what the session could and could not observe.

steps.title: Make the brief useful
steps.copy: Edit the Markdown brief, download it, and share the selected output through an expiring, read-only link.

pricing.title: Start a conversation.
pricing.support: Vistralo is available by invitation. Public plans and free-trial limits have not been announced.
pricing.note: Tell us what you want to capture and how your team works.

closing.title: Start with a site you love.
closing.support: Bring a reference. Keep your own content and brand.

faq.question: Which websites can I record?
faq.answer: The current website capture flow visits public pages reachable by its browser. Sign-in walls, private networks and some interactions can limit coverage. The report records those limits. Only capture material you are authorized to use.

faq.question: Does Vistralo copy a website for me?
faq.answer: The current product creates capture evidence and a visual brief. It does not automatically build or rebrand a website. Use your own content and assets when your team builds from the brief.

faq.question: Do I need to code?
faq.answer: You can review and edit the brief without writing code. Implementing a website from it is a separate step for your team or coding tools.

faq.question: What does my team receive?
faq.answer: An editable Markdown brief with observed layout and motion, captured frames, reference timings and coverage notes. The exact output depends on what the capture could observe.

faq.question: Who can see my recordings?
faq.answer: Cloud project access is restricted to the owning account. Creating a share link makes the selected output accessible to anyone with that link until expiry or revocation. Do not include sensitive information in shared material.

faq.question: Can I edit the brief?
faq.answer: Yes. Edit the Markdown text in the project’s brief view before downloading or sharing it.
